source.note: Search summary (results: parkcitymountain.com "Mountain Stats, Elevation & Snowfall" page, Visit Park City): 7,300 acres, 41 lifts, two base areas (Mountain Village and Canyons Village). Trail count, lift types and ability split not captured. Planned lift upgrades (Silverlode to an eight-seat chair, Eagle/Eaglet to a six-seat chair, Crescent retrofit) are targeted for 2027-28 (Park Record / TownLift, Sep 2026), so they do not change 2026-27.

character: One of the largest ski areas in the US, created when Vail Resorts linked the Park City and Canyons ski areas for the 2015-16 season. It has two main bases, Park City Mountain Village and Canyons Village, plus a Town Lift from historic Main Street, and it is ticketed separately from neighbouring Deer Valley.
learning: Reference note: beginner areas exist at both bases (the First Time lift area at Park City Mountain Village and learning terrain at Canyons Village), and lessons run through the resort ski and ride school. Confirm current learning lifts and lesson products.

Search summary: 2025-26 opening Dec. 5, 2025 (Ski Utah 2025-26 opening-dates list). Mountain Village closed for the season in March 2026 (TownLift: https://townlift.com/2026/03/park-city-mountain-pulls-the-plug-on-mountain-village-this-weekend/) while the Canyons Village closing was still "TBD", so no single closing date is recorded.

season.notes: 2026-27: planned opening Nov. 20, 2026 (Vail Resorts release; search summary 2026-09-30). No 2026-27 closing date was found. In 2025-26 the Mountain Village side closed in March 2026 while the Canyons Village closing was still to be decided.

prices.note: 2026-27 peak-day adult ticket $369. Vail Resorts prices dynamically and sells cheaper tickets 4+ weeks ahead; non-peak and advance prices were not captured.

research.confidenceNotes: Upgraded on 2026-09-30 from reference-only using batched web searches (search-result summaries; page fetching is blocked, so no official page was read directly). Search-summary facts: planned 2026-27 opening, 2025-26 opening, acreage and lift count, the 2026-27 peak ticket price and the stats page. Still Piste reference data (unverified): identity, coordinates and weather points, operator, elevations, features, airport drive estimates and transfers. Summaries sometimes blend several result pages, so the source URL on each fact group is the most specific result that carried it — confirm at source before relying on it. Snow-report, lift-status and trail-map links follow the URL pattern shared by all Vail Resorts sites (terrain-and-lift-status.aspx and mountain-info.aspx were seen in results for sister resorts); they were not individually opened.
